lines.japanese: 「あっ」
lines.english: “Oh!”

lines.japanese: 校門の側へ寄りかかる影ひとつ。
lines.english: A lone figure leaned against the side of the school gate.

lines.japanese: もう下校時刻はだいぶ過ぎてるから、あたりに他の生徒の影は見当たらなかった。
lines.english: Dismissal time was long past, and there were no other students in sight.

lines.japanese: 「やあ小鳩。悪い、待たせちゃったかな」
lines.english: “Hey, Kobato. Sorry. Did I keep you waiting?”

lines.japanese: 「ううん。ぜんぜんちっとも待ってないよ」
lines.english: “No. I haven't been waiting at all.”

lines.japanese: うう、森里君と遊んでいたせいでちょっぴり遅れちゃったのに、何事もなかったかのように振るまってくれて……なんて優しいんだ。ここが家の外じゃなければ今すぐ抱きしめたい。
lines.english: Ooh. I'd run a little late because I was playing with Morisato, yet she acted as though nothing had happened... What a kind girl. If we weren't outside the house, I would hug her this instant.

lines.japanese: いや、なにを恥ずかしがることがあろうか。さっきから警備員のおじさんがギラリと不審者を見るような目で睨んでるけど、俺たちは兄妹だ。つまり抱きしめても法的に問題はない。
lines.english: No, what was there to be embarrassed about? The security guard had been glaring at me for some time as though at a suspicious character, but we were siblings. In other words, there was no legal problem with an embrace.

lines.japanese: うふん、小鳩ぉ～ん！　俺は愛妹を抱擁しようと、両手を広げて──
lines.english: Ooh, Kobatooo! I spread my arms to embrace my beloved little sister—

lines.japanese: 「じつはね、ここで鳴ちゃんさんと出会って、ふたりで話してたんだ。だからちっとも待ってないよ」
lines.english: “Actually, I ran into Naru—Miss Naru here, and we've been talking. So I haven't waited at all.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、どーもー。今日はご相伴に与らせていただけるそうでー。お世話になりますー」
lines.english: “Oh, hellooo. I hear you'll be treating me to dinner today. Thank you for having meee.”

lines.japanese: 「あれー？　どうしましたドラさん、そんな両手ひろげて」
lines.english: “Hmm? What's wrong, Dora? Why're your arms spread like that?”

lines.japanese: 「わあ～い、警備員さぁ～ん！」
lines.english: “Yaaay, Mr. Security Guard!”

lines.japanese: 引っ込みがつかなくなった俺は、とりあえず警備員さんと熱いハグを交わした。
lines.english: Unable to back down, I shared a passionate embrace with the security guard instead.

lines.japanese: で、そのまま三人でだらだら話しながら夕食を終え、現在は食後の喫茶タイムだった。
lines.english: The three of us idled through dinner in conversation, and now we were enjoying tea afterward.

lines.japanese: 「あのー、ところでずっと気になっていたことがあるんですよー」
lines.english: “Um, by the way, there's something I've been wondering about this whole timeee.”

lines.japanese: 「俺のハンサムかい？　やめてくれ、俺はひとりの女性だけを選ぶことはできない」
lines.english: “My handsomeness? Please, don't. I could never choose only one woman.”

lines.japanese: 「ドラさんが着てるのって、美空学園の制服じゃありません？」
lines.english: “Isn't that the Misora Academy uniform you're wearing, Dora?”

lines.japanese: 「くっ」
lines.english: “Ghk.”

lines.japanese: やはり気になっていたか。俺が学生だったと知られれば面倒なことになる。仕方ない、俺はいつもの言い訳を使った。
lines.english: So she had noticed. If she discovered I was a student, things would grow complicated. I had no choice but to use my usual excuse.

lines.japanese: 「コスプレなんだ」
lines.english: “It's cosplay.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、コスプレですかー」
lines.english: “Oh, cosplayyy.”

lines.japanese: 「それにしてもびっくりですー。ドラさんお仕事もされてるから、てっきり社会人なのかと思ってました」
lines.english: “Still, what a surprise. Since you work too, Dora, I thought you were already out of school.”

lines.japanese: 「ぐうっ」
lines.english: “Urgh.”

lines.japanese: いつもの言い訳がまったく通じていなかった。
lines.english: My usual excuse had failed completely.

lines.japanese: 鳳鳴、か……。
lines.english: Naru Ohtori...

lines.japanese: いっそのこと正直に話してしまおうかとも思ったが、もう少しだけ様子見をさせてもらおう。悪いやつじゃないとは思うが、そう安々と話すことでもない。
lines.english: Part of me considered telling her the truth, but I would watch her a little longer. She didn't seem like a bad person, but this wasn't something to reveal lightly.

lines.japanese: 「まあ、そういうわけで、学生さんだったんだ。苦学生だからアルバイトもしてるんだ。なんか恵んで」
lines.english: “So yes, I'm a student. I work because I'm struggling to put myself through school. Give me something.”

lines.japanese: 「そっかー、ドラさん学生さんだったんだー。くはー、ちっとも気付かなかったー。ドラさんほんとにミステリアスですよー謎の男ですよー。きゃー影のある男素敵ー」
lines.english: “Ohhh, so Dora was a student. Whew, I never noticed at all. You really are mysterious, Dora. A man of mysteryyy. Oh, a man with shadows—how dreamy.”

lines.japanese: 「お、おい、そんなに誉めるなよ。て、照れちゃうだろ」
lines.english: “D-don't praise me so much. You'll embarrass me.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、でも私ー、作業服着てるような職人系の方が好みかもー」
lines.english: “Oh, but I think I prefer craftsmen in work clothes.”

lines.japanese: 「うるさいよ。なんで俺が、鳳鳴の好みに沿う男にならなくちゃいけないんだよ」
lines.english: “Shut up. Why do I have to become the sort of man Naru Ohtori prefers?”

lines.japanese: 「うふふ。大人の女に振りまわされて動揺してるな？」
lines.english: “Heehee. A mature woman’s got you all flustered, hasn’t she?”

lines.japanese: 「その自信はどっから湧いてくるんだよ」
lines.english: “Where does that confidence come from?”

lines.japanese: 「あー、体のラインとスタイルですー」
lines.english: “Oh, from the lines and proportions of my bodyyy.”

lines.japanese: 「夕食後にこんなもの頼んだ現実を見ろよ」
lines.english: “Face the reality of what you ordered after dinner.”

lines.japanese: 俺は鳳鳴の手元へ、彼女の注文した生ハムチーズのパニーニをずいと押しこんだ。
lines.english: I shoved Naru Ohtori's prosciutto-and-cheese panini toward her.

lines.japanese: 「あー、なんか話題かえなくちゃー。あー、あーそだー、美空学園ってどんな雰囲気ですかー？　なんだか外から見るとスタイリッシュってイメージですけどー」
lines.english: “Oh, I need to change the subject. Um, right! What's Misora Academy like? From the outside, it has this stylish image.”

lines.japanese: 「昨日、クラスの子の会話が聞こえてきて、ソラ学はいい、設備も整ってる、みたいなこと言ってましたよ」
lines.english: “I overheard some girls in my class yesterday saying Sora Academy was great and had excellent facilities.”

lines.japanese: 「ん？　ああ、そんないいもんじゃないない。ただ単に校舎を最近新しくして綺麗ってだけだ」
lines.english: “Hmm? Oh, it isn't anything special. They only rebuilt the school recently, so the buildings look nice.”

lines.japanese: 「でもソラ学の男の子って人気あるみたいですよー？　今日も教室の真ん中あたりで、うちのクラスの子たちも話してましたし」
lines.english: “But boys from Sora Academy are apparently popular. Girls near the middle of my classroom were talking about them today too.”

lines.japanese: 「マジか。よし、今すぐ紹介して」
lines.english: “Seriously? Great. Introduce me right now.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: なんだ。なんだその顔は。冗談に決まってるじゃないか、そんなに困った顔しなくても──
lines.english: What was with that face? I was obviously joking. She didn't have to look so troubled—

lines.japanese: 「あれ？」
lines.english: “Wait.”

lines.japanese: ──困った顔、なのかコレ？
lines.english: —Was that a troubled look?

lines.japanese: いや、そういうんじゃなくて、コレはなんか、ちょっと動転しているというか……。
lines.english: No, it wasn't quite that. She looked a little shaken...

lines.japanese: 「あー、それはそのー……やっぱり、キューちゃんに悪いからやめときますー。あはー」
lines.english: “Um, well... I think I'd better not. It wouldn't be fair to Kyuu. Ahaha.”

lines.japanese: うーん、この反応は……もしかして……アレか？
lines.english: Hmm. That reaction... Could it be... that?

lines.japanese: あの、俺でいうところの、かつてのタカシ的なアレ……人間関係に恵まれていない感じのアレ……。
lines.english: That thing I used to have going on as Takashi... that thing where you’re not having much luck making friends...

lines.japanese: 「ふーむ……」
青春時代に苦悩はつきものだ。タカシだった俺も学校ではちょっと浮いていた。友達といえば森里君ぐらいしかいなかったからな。そう、それだ。
lines.english: Trouble was part of youth. When I was Takashi, I'd been something of an outsider at school myself. Morisato was practically my only friend. Yes. That was it.

lines.japanese: 「なあ、鳳鳴。もし悩み事や抱えてる事があるなら、遠慮なく相談してくれよ」
lines.english: “Hey, Naru Ohtori. If something's worrying you or weighing on you, come talk to me anytime.”

lines.japanese: 「へっ？」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「え、えっ？　何ですかいきなり？」
lines.english: “W-wait. Where did that come from?”

lines.japanese: 「何って、いまちょっと、元気なかっただろう。俺たちは友達じゃないか。友達を元気付けてあげたいと思うのは普通の感情だぞ」
lines.english: “What do you mean? You looked down for a moment. We're friends. Wanting to cheer up a friend is the most natural feeling in the world.”

lines.japanese: 「もちろん話したくなったときでいい。だけど、鳳鳴には俺や小鳩という友達がいることを、いつも忘れないでくれよ？」
lines.english: “You only have to talk when you feel ready. But never forget that you have friends in Kobato and me, okay?”
“Whew...”

lines.japanese: 俺の熱弁に、彼女は呆然となった。つまりいつもの鳳鳴に戻った。うん、でも口は閉じた方がいいよ。
lines.english: My impassioned speech left her dumbstruck. In other words, she had returned to the usual Naru Ohtori. Yes, but she should probably close her mouth.

lines.japanese: 「はーはー、なるほどー……あはー」
lines.english: “Whew, whew. I see... Ahaha.”

lines.japanese: 「ん、どうした」
lines.english: “Hmm? What's wrong?”

lines.japanese: 「いえー、やっぱりタイミングなんだなと思いましてー」
lines.english: “Nothing. I was only thinking that it really is a matter of timing.”

lines.japanese: 「そーですよねー。何事も最初からそうそう上手くいくはずがありませんよね。時間がたてば変わることもありますもんねー」
lines.english: “Right. Nothing ever goes perfectly from the start. Things can change as time passes.”

lines.japanese: 「ど、どうした。急に悟りを開いたように」
lines.english: “Wh-what came over you? You sound as though you've attained enlightenment.”

lines.japanese: 「はいー。実は私、ドラさんの言うとおりちょっと悩んでましてー。えー、教室でちょっとトラブっちゃったと言いますかー」
lines.english: “Yes. Just as you guessed, Dora, something has been troubling me. You might say I ran into a little trouble in class.”

lines.japanese: ああ、まあ、やっぱりそうか。なに、よくあることだ。
lines.english: Ah. So I was right. Well, that kind of thing happened all the time.

lines.japanese: 「ドラさんとキューちゃんが、クラスにいればいいなーなんて思いましたけど……そんなはずないですよねー」
lines.english: “I wished Dora and Kyuu were in my class... but of course, that could never happen.”

lines.japanese: 「でも、ドラさんとキューちゃんっぽいひとなら、いるかもしれないですよね」
lines.english: “But there might be people like Dora and Kyuu there.”

lines.japanese: 「ははは、俺みたいなひと？　馬鹿を言うな、俺という存在はこの世に一つしかない崇高な存在だぞ」
lines.english: “Ha ha ha! Someone like me? Don't be absurd. This world contains only one sublime being such as myself.”

lines.japanese: 「よーし、なんだか元気が湧いてきたぞー。明日も鳴ちゃんファイトー！」
lines.english: “All right! I can feel my energy coming back! Naru will do her best again tomorrow!”

lines.japanese: 「聞けよ！」
lines.english: “Listen to me!”

lines.japanese: ツッコミは入れておいたものの、鳳鳴に元気が出てよかった。友達として嬉しいじゃないか。
lines.english: I had to give her a comeback, but I was glad Naru Ohtori was feeling better. What friend wouldn’t be?

lines.japanese: しかも「クラスにいてほしかった」なんて、俺にとって最高の誉め言葉だ。
lines.english: And “I wish you were in my class” was the highest compliment she could have paid me.

lines.japanese: 俺だって、こいつと同じクラスだったら、さぞかし楽しい学園生活が──
lines.english: If I were in her class, our school days together would surely be great fun—

lines.japanese: ──あれ？　もしかして、鳳鳴と俺って、相性いいのか？
lines.english: —Wait. Could Naru Ohtori and I actually be a good match?

lines.japanese: それに（推測だが）こいつは小鳩とプロポーションが近い気もする。つまり、外見的には俺の好みのタイプということになる。
lines.english: What's more, though this was only a guess, her proportions seemed close to Kobato's. That made her physically my type.

lines.japanese: はっ！　もしかしてこれが、小鳩に次ぐ運命の出会い！？
lines.english: Wait! Could this be my fated meeting second only to Kobato?!

lines.japanese: うむむ、これは新しい発見だ。今後は鳳鳴への対応を考えあらためた方がいいのかもしれない。
lines.english: Hmm. This was a new discovery. Perhaps I ought to reconsider the way I treated Naru Ohtori from now on.

lines.japanese: 「いやー、正面から友達なんて言葉、久しぶりに聞きましたよー。さすがドラさん、乙女の心を隼掴みにするのが上手いですねー」
lines.english: “Wow. It's been a long time since anybody called me a friend to my face. That's Dora for you. You sure know how to snatch a maiden's heart in your talons.”

lines.japanese: 「フフ、そうかい？　だが君さえ良ければ、それだけじゃ終わらないかもしれないゼ？」
lines.english: “Heh. Do I? Yet if you wish it, perhaps our relationship need not end there.”

lines.japanese: 「ドラさんカンジ変わりましたよねー。まさかドラさんから友達なんて言葉が出てくるとは、露ほども思ってませんでしたからー」
lines.english: “You really have changed, Dora. I never dreamed I'd hear the word ‘friend’ from you.”

lines.japanese: 「フフフ、大人の男の魅力に惑わされてどきどきしてるな？」
lines.english: “Heh heh heh. A mature man’s charms have got you all flustered, haven’t they?”

lines.japanese: 「あー、はいはい。惑わされました。どきどきしてます」
lines.english: “Oh, yes, yes. I’m all flustered. My heart’s pounding.”

lines.japanese: 「よせよ。俺に惚れても火傷するだけさ」
lines.english: “Careful. Fall for me and you'll only get burned.”

lines.japanese: 「きゃー、そういうハードボイルド系素敵ー。もっとハードボイルド見せてー」
lines.english: “Oh, how dreamy and hard-boiled. Show me more hard-boiled Dora.”

lines.japanese: 「誰に見られたいわけじゃない。こういう生き方しかできないだけさ」
lines.english: “I do not live for the gaze of others. This is simply the only way I know how to live.”

lines.japanese: 「きゃー、素敵ー。女の子の要望に応えてくれる律儀な男の子素敵ー」
lines.english: “Oh, dreamy. A conscientious boy who gives a girl exactly what she asks for. Dreamyyy.”

lines.japanese: 「あーでも私ー、ちょっと前の、ギラついてたオレ様スタイルの方が好みだったかもー」
lines.english: “Although I might have preferred the old, aggressive, egotistical Dora.”

lines.japanese: 「うるさいよ。口閉じなさい口」
lines.english: “Shut up. Close your mouth.”

lines.japanese: うん、やっぱり駄目だな。
lines.english: Yes. This was never going to work.

lines.japanese: 漫才をやる分には相性いいのかもしれないが、レンアイとやらにはまったく発展する気配がない。
lines.english: We might have good chemistry as a comedy duo, but there was no sign whatsoever that it would develop into romance.

lines.japanese: しかし芸人としての腕は買いたい。これからもいい相方でいてほしいものだ。
lines.english: Still, I valued her skill as a performer. I hoped she would remain a worthy partner.

lines.japanese: まったく、鳳鳴の級友たちも見る目がないな。話してみればこんなに面白いやつ、そうそういないのに。
lines.english: Honestly, Naru Ohtori's classmates had no eye for people. Few were this entertaining once you actually spoke to them.

lines.japanese: 「ねー、キューちゃん」
lines.english: “Hey, Kyuu.”

lines.japanese: 「ふえっ！？　あ、なな、なんでしょう？」
lines.english: “Eep?! Y-yes? What is it?”

lines.japanese: 「ぼーっとして、どしたの？　キューちゃんとは三年ずれてるから、校舎にいる時間も被らないのが残念だなー」
lines.english: “You were spacing out. What's wrong? We're three school years apart, so it's too bad we'll never even be in the building at the same time.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ？　あ、ああ、そうでした。かぶりません、私と鳴ちゃんさんは少しもかぶりません」
lines.english: “What? Oh, yes. That's right. We won't overlap. Naru and I won't overlap at all.”

lines.japanese: 「そんなに嫌がらなくてもいいよー？」
lines.english: “You don't have to hate the idea that much.”

lines.japanese: 「うああっ、すす、すみませんっ」
lines.english: “Ah! I-I'm sorry!”

lines.japanese: 「あ、そうだ。いいこと思いついた。鳳鳴さ、小鳩と同じ教室通えばいいじゃん。絶対バレないって」
lines.english: “Oh, I know. Naru Ohtori, you should just attend Kobato's class. Nobody would ever notice.”

lines.japanese: 「女教師がお好みですかー？　うふふー、もう男の子なんだからーん」
lines.english: “Oh? You like female teachers? Heehee. Such a boyyy.”

lines.japanese: 「うわ、どんなことでも前向きに捉えようとしてる」
lines.english: “Wow. She's trying to put a positive spin on absolutely everything.”

lines.japanese: 素晴らしい心構えだ。もし機会があれば、俺の友達をもりもり紹介してあげたいと思った。
lines.english: An admirable attitude. If the chance arose, I would enthusiastically introduce her to all my friends.
